assertion_analysis.318: Removing an export or selecting the wrong owner makes facade and independently listed home disagree; the dropped-admit_once control fails this assertion.
assertion_analysis.319: Omitting a binding from facade __dir__ makes the independently enumerated name absent.
assertion_analysis.330: Breaking facade patch reads makes the assigned sentinel differ; on its own this is a local assignment check, paired with the independent owner assertion at 331.
assertion_analysis.331: Removing the __setattr__ forwarding loop leaves the owner original rather than the sentinel supplied through the facade.
assertion_analysis.332: Broken patch undo leaves the facade value different from the object captured before patching.
assertion_analysis.333: Broken patch undo leaves the owner value different from its independently captured original.
assertion_analysis.339: Restoring an unqualified stale _now binding inside _utc_now ignores the facade patch and returns a different timestamp.
assertion_analysis.357: A stale admit_once binding or lost service result merge fails to return the patched admission payload; this tests routing rather than admission policy.
assertion_analysis.358: A stale release binding or discarded release result loses the injected object identity.
assertion_analysis.359: A stale service clock binding fails the independently fixed timestamp.
assertion_analysis.360: A stale landing clock binding fails the independently fixed timestamp across module boundaries.
assertion_analysis.361: A missing or stale verdict callback leaves records empty or holding a different result.
assertion_analysis.370: Failing to forward a dependency replacement to launching leaves launching.runs original.
assertion_analysis.371: Failing to forward a dependency replacement to shared leaves shared.runs original.
assertion_analysis.372: Failing to restore the launching dependency leaves the replacement object installed.
assertion_analysis.373: Failing to restore the shared dependency leaves the replacement object installed.
assertion_analysis.374: Failing to restore facade reads leaves the replacement installed.
assertion_analysis.383: A facade deletion that leaves the owning binding reachable keeps hasattr true.
assertion_analysis.384: A facade deletion that fails to remove imported dependency bindings keeps launching.runs present.
assertion_analysis.385: Failure to restore the deleted facade binding leaves it absent or different from the pre-patch object.
assertion_analysis.386: Failure to restore the deleted imported launching dependency leaves it absent or different.
assertion_analysis.395: Removing a public export from __all__ or exporting implementation helpers changes the set derived independently from SURFACE.
assertion_analysis.397: Binding a star-imported name to a different object fails the identity comparison against facade access.
assertion_analysis.403: Adding an unaccounted package module or dropping an expected responsibility file changes the independently listed module set.
assertion_analysis.405: Combining responsibilities into any module above 2000 lines fails the literal size bound.

assertion_independence_note: Assertions using injected sentinels and payloads verify forwarding, restoration or callback reachability, each with an independent owner or observable result; none merely compares two aliases of an input without code-dependent behavior. They do not claim to test the policies replaced by mocks.
